cases.facts: Builder ne flats unsold chhod diye aur stock-in-trade mein dikhaya. Department ne un par bhi notional ALV se rent ka addition kar diya for A.Y. 2014-15.
cases.issue: Kya unsold flats (stock-in-trade) par notional rent addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha, builder ke unsold flats par jab tak rent actual mein nahi aata, tab tak notional ALV se rent ka addition nahi ho sakta. Addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Jo flats stock-in-trade mein hain aur unsold hain, un par jab tak actual rent nahi mil raha, notional rent nahi lagega. Apni books mein position saaf dikhayein.

cases.case_name: D.Pitchairajan Vs Assistant Commissioner(ST)(FAC) (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Ek proprietor ke marne ke baad bhi department ne GST assessment orders pass kiye. Family ne challenge kiya ki order galat hai.
cases.issue: Kya marne ke baad proprietor ke naam pe assessment ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, jab aadmi mar gaya, uske naam pe order pass nahi ho sakta. Pure assessment ko wapas bhej diya, lekin 10% deposit condition ke saath fresh proceedings ke liye bola.
cases.takeaway: Agar proprietor mar jaye, to GST assessment order bina legal heir ko notice diye valid nahi. Legal heirs timely information department ko de, warna fresh assessment ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Pegasus Properties Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne apne unsold flats ko stock-in-trade mein dikhaya. Department ne deemed rent add kar diya, jabki flats bika nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya unsold flats (stock-in-trade) par deemed rent add ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya ki jab tak flat bika nahi hai ya rent pe nahi diya hai, deemed rent ka addition nahi ho sakta. Addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Developer apne unsold inventory par deemed rent se tension na le jab tak rent aane ki actual situation nahi hai. Apni return mein is position ko clear rakhein.

cases.case_name: Dhanji Murji Hirani Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Department ne reassessment open ki, lekin higher officer ka mandatory Section 151 approval unsigned tha aur bas mechanically diya gaya tha. Matlab officer ne dhyan se dekha hi nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment valid hai jab Section 151 approval sahi se nahi mila?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola jab proper signed approval nahi hai aur officer ne soch samajh kar decision nahi diya, reassessment process radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment open karte waqt Section 151 ka approval signed and mindful hona chahiye. Agar aapko notice mile toh aap certified copy mang kar verify karein.

cases.case_name: Kemexel Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd. Vs State of Punjab And Others (Punjab And Haryana High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne taxpayer ka assessment pass kiya bina usko sunwaye. Taxpayer ne bola ki unko notice ya sunwayi ka mauka hi nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya bina opportunity of hearing, assessment order valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne assessment order ko wapas bhej diya. Bola, bina mandatory hearing diye GST assessment nahi ho sakta under Section 75(4).
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko GST assessment ka notice aaye, toh ensure karein ki aapko hearing ka clear mauka mile. Agar nahi mila, toh order ko High Court mein challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Ram Niwas Gupta (ITAT Agra Bench)
cases.facts: Is case mein husband sirf apni wife ke bank account ka authorized signatory tha. Department ne wife ke account mein aayi 1.89 crore ki deposit ko husband ki income maan liya, kyunki PAN galat tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf wrong PAN ya signatory hone se wife ke account ki deposit ko husband ki income mana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki account wife ka hi tha, husband toh sirf signatory tha. PAN mistake se yeh income husband ki nahi ban jaati. Addition hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap kisi aur ke account ke signatory hain, toh bas is wajah se unki deposit aapki income nahi banegi. PAN galat hai toh bhi account holder dekhna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Naeem Sirajuddin Tirmizi Vs PCIT (Central) (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.section: Section 263 (revision of orders), Section 271D (penalty for cash loans)
cases.facts: PCIT ne Section 263 mein AO ke order ko revise kiya tha aur Section 271D penalty lagayi thi. Case 7 saal purana tha.
cases.issue: Kya penalty bina proper jurisdiction ke laga sakte hain, especially purane cases mein?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki AO ko jurisdiction nahi tha aur penalty 1 April 2025 ke pehle nahi lag sakti thi. Section 263 ka revision quash kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Section 271D penalty lagane se pehle dekh lo ki AO ko jurisdiction hai ya nahi, aur date relevant hai ya nahi. Purane cases mein jaldi penalty mat maan lo.

cases.case_name: Indo Nissin Foods Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT, Bangalore Bench)
cases.facts: Indo Nissin (Top Ramen) ka TP case tha. Department ne ₹41.82 crore ka AMP (advertisement/marketing) adjustment kiya aur kuch comparables add kiye. Company ne mana ki direct arrangement nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina koi specific arrangement ke AMP expense pe itna bada TP adjustment sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki sirf AE transactions par hi adjustment ho sakta hai. Five comparables hata diye aur pura ₹41.82 crore ka adjustment delete kar diya, kyunki proper agreement nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar AMP ya TP adjustment ho toh sirf AE se related transactions dekho aur direct evidence of arrangement hona chahiye. Bina agreement, routine marketing pe adjustment nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: CHNHB Health Insurance Co. Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Company ne exempt income kamaya tha. AO ne total investments par Section 14A kaa disallowance laga diya. Assessee ne bola sirf unhi investments par calculate karo jahan se exempt income aayi.
cases.issue: Section 14A disallowance ka computation sirf exempt income yielding investments par hoga ya sab pe?
cases.held: Court ne bola sirf wahi investments count honge jahan se exempt income aayi hai. Case wapas AO ko diya, dubara compute karein.
cases.takeaway: Section 14A lagate waqt bas unhi investments ko include karo jahan se actual exempt income mili ho. Pure portfolio pe mat lagao.

cases.case_name: Nitesh Kumar Gadiya Vs ITO (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Assessee ne shares bech kar LTCG dikhaya. Department ne penny stock bol kar Section 68 aur 69C se add kar diya. Assessee ne pura documentary evidence lagaya.
cases.issue: Kya documentary evidence hone par penny stock sale se LTCG reject kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola documents sufficient hain, LTCG genuine hai. Section 68 aur 69C ki addition hata di.
cases.takeaway: Shares bech kar agar LTCG dikhate ho toh sabhi documents ready rakho—purchase, sale, demat evidence. Paper sahi hua toh addition nahi hogi, chahe stock penny ho.

cases.case_name: Smt. Jayanthi Seeman Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Assessee ke kuch cash deposits aur agricultural income ko AO ne add kar diya tha. Interest claim bhi tha. Section 54 ki verification ke liye kuch issue tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit aur agricultural income additions valid hain, aur interest claim allowed hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne kuch additions hata diye, business interest allow kar diya, aur Section 54 wale matter ko wapas AO ko verification ke liye bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Cash/jamaat aur agriculture income dikhate waqt sabhi papers sahi rakho. Section 54 claim ka proof bhi proper tayar raho kyunki kabhi kabhi AO dubara check ke liye bol sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Pravin C. Bokadia Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Assessee ne Lifeline Drugs ki shares bech ke LTCG claim kiya tha. AO ne penny stock bol ke exemption rok di. Assessee par price rigging ka koi proof nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf penny stock allegation par section 10(38) exemption roki ja sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, kyunki koi link nahi mila bogus transaction se, exemption milni chahiye. Sirf suspicion se exemption nahi roki ja sakti.
cases.takeaway: LTCG exemption claim karne par agar aap par koi strong evidence nahi hai toh AO ke suspicion par hi exemption nahi ruqi ja sakti.

cases.case_name: Rolex Rings Limited Vs DCIT/ACIT (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Rolex Rings Limited ka case tha. Company par ₹5.40 crore ki accommodation entry ka ilzaam laga tha. Department ne reassessment kiya, lekin sanction galat tha, koi direct sambandh nahi mila aur cross-examination ka mauka bhi nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment sahi process follow ki bina ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya. Sanction process theek nahi tha aur acche se sambandh establish nahi hua tha. Cross-examination nahi milne par bhi court ne department ke khilaf faisla diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko cross-examination ka mauka nahi milta ya sanction process galat hai, to aap reassessment ko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Geeta Satsang Ashram Samiti Vs Ward Exemption (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Geeta Satsang Ashram Samiti ne 80G exemption maangi thi. Ashram ke religious kharch total ka 5% se kam tha. Bhagavad Gita ki teachings par focus hai, jo kisi ek dharm ke liye nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya 80G approval mil sakti hai jab religious kharch 5% se kam ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne 80G approval allow kiya. Court bola ki teachings non-denominational hain aur religious expenditure kanuni had se kam hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka trust ya society ka religious kharch total ka 5% se kam hai, to aapko 80G approval milne ka pura chance hai. Non-denominational activities dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Ekchaka Samabaya Krishi Unnayan Samity Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Yeh ek co-operative society ka case tha. Cash deposit ki wajah se assessment phir se khola gaya par phir is issue par koi addition nahi ki.
cases.issue: Jab reopening ka main reason pe addition nahi hui, to kya assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment process ko radd kar diya kyunki reopening ka main reason pe kuch bhi add nahi hua tha. Bas is basis par case reopen nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein reopening ka main reason pe koi addition nahi hoti, to poora reopening null ho sakta hai. Aise mein aap challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Rameshwar Fakirchand Totala Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Rameshwar Fakirchand Totala par ₹10.52 lakh ki Section 69 (disclosed income ka proof na ho to addition) ke tehat income add kar di gayi. WhatsApp chat evidence use kiya gaya tha, bina certificate ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina original certificate ke WhatsApp chats pe addition ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. WhatsApp chats bina Section 65B certificate ke admissible nahi thi. Independent evidence bhi nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Digital evidence jaise WhatsApp chats ka Section 65B certificate zaroori hai. Agar certificate nahi hai, to aap addition ko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Endel Retail And Customer Care Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ye company ne foreign tax credit claim kiya tha par Form 67 delay se file hua tha. Department ne credit disallow kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya foreign tax credit mil sakta hai agar Form 67 time se nahi file hua?
cases.held: ITAT ne credit allow kiya. Pehle ke apne hi decision ko follow kiya aur decide kiya ki delay ke bawajood credit mil sakta hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar Form 67 late ho gaya hai, to bhi apne foreign tax credit ka claim try kar sakte ho. Delay ke reason ko sahi se explain karo.

cases.case_name: Omkara Assets Reconstruction Pvt Ltd Vs Sahjun Impex Trading Pvt Ltd (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Is case mein company ke winding-up proceedings NCLT ko transfer karne ka challenge kiya gaya tha. Secured creditor ne kuch assets bech diye the, lekin company revive ho sakti hai ya nahi yeh mudda tha.
cases.issue: Kya asset sale ke baad bhi winding-up proceedings NCLT ko transfer ki ja sakti hai revival ke liye?
cases.held: Court ne kaha, asset sale se revival impossible nahi ho jata. NCLT ko transfer sahi hai. Challenge ko dismiss kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar company ke kuch assets bik bhi gaye hain, to bhi winding-up matter NCLT ko ja sakta hai aur wahan revive ho sakta hai. Practically, secured lenders bhi NCLT route try kar sakte hain agar revival ka chance bacha ho.

cases.case_name: Arvind Kumar Singhavi Vs ITO (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Assessee ne GP ka estimation challenge kiya aur TDS ke kuch amount pe disallowance hui. ₹10.45 lakh ki GP addition thi aur ₹10,780 ka TDS ka dispute tha.
cases.issue: Kya estimated GP addition sahi thi aur TDS ka disallowance justify hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne ₹10.45 lakh GP addition hata di, par ₹10,780 TDS disallowance ko maintain kiya. Baaki teen disallowances bhi delete kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke pass proper GP records hain aur department bas estimate par addition kar raha hai, to court aapke haq mein decision de sakta hai. Lekin TDS disallowance documentation pura hona chahiye.

cases.case_name: Pravinkumar Ramjibhai Patel Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ko BSNL VRS compensation mila tha. Department ne Section 10(10B) exemption se mana kar diya aur rectification ka attempt hua.
cases.issue: Kya BSNL VRS pe Section 10(10B) exemption milni chahiye thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 10(10B) exemption di aur pehle ke judgements ka reference diya. Rectification ko allow nahi kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko VRS compensation mila hai, to Section 10(10B) ka pura benefit claim kar sakte ho. Appeal mein bhi yeh position strong hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Goel Jewellers Overseas Corp (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Demonetisation ke time cash sales hui thi. Department ne pura ₹3.89 crore cash sales ko Section 68 ke under questionable maan liya aur addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya sirf suspicion pe demonetisation cash sales ko Section 68 addition kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha, kewal shak par addition nahi ho sakti jab tak supporting records hain. Revenue ke appeal ko dismiss kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation cash sales ka proper documentation hai to sirf suspicion basis pe Section 68 addition nahi chalegi. Sab sales evidence sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: Windlas Jewellers Vs ITO (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: Jeweller ne demonetisation ke time cash deposit kiya. Department kehte hain yeh unexplained hai aur Section 68 se addition kari.
cases.issue: Kya demonetisation cash sales, jab records audited hain, ko unexplained income maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola, audited books of account aur records hain to sirf suspicion se addition nahi ho sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne demonetisation ke dauraan cash sales ki hai to pure documents, bills aur bank entries strong hone chahiye. Audited accounts se bahut madad milegi.

cases.case_name: Vidyasagar Samabay Krishi Unnayan Samity Ltd Vs ACIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Assessee ne demonetisation ke baad cash deposit bank mein kiya. Department ne is amount ko unexplained income maan liya Section 69A ke under.
cases.issue: Kya properly explained demonetisation bank deposit ko unexplained income bol sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola agar cash deposit explained hai, to Section 69A ka addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation period ki cash deposits ka source clearly dikhana zaroori hai. Proper paper trail ho to Section 69A ki dikkat nahi hogi.

cases.case_name: Heena Irfan Bepari Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Heena Irfan Bepari ka case tha. Department ne fir se assessment khol diya tha, par approval galat authority se liya tha. PCIT ne section 151 ki approval di thi jab higher authority ki zarurat thi.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment ki sanction sahi authority se mili thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne ye addition radd kar diya. Wajah ye thi ki sanction sahi officer se nahi li gayi thi, jo law ke mutabiq required thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar department reassessment khol raha hai to dhyan se dekho ki approval kis officer se li gayi hai. Galat authority se ho to poora case radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Jeeten Jayshukhlal Mehta Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai Bench)
cases.facts: Jeeten Jayshukhlal Mehta ka Mumbai ITAT mein case tha. Department ne Section 69A ke andar 27.39 lakh ka addition kiya tha, lekin assessee ne third-party ledger reconcile kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 69A ki addition justified thi jab explanation mil gaya?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 69A ki addition hata di kyunki ledger se sab match ho gaya. Lekin ₹4.45 lakh ki travel expense ka koi proper proof nahi tha, toh wo disallow kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi cash ya deposits pe addition ho to third party ledger ya statements collect kar lo. Travel expenses ka actual document zarur sambhal ke rakho, warna wo disallow ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Fiserv Merchant Solutions Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT, Mumbai Bench)
cases.facts: Fiserv Merchant Solutions ka case tha. Department ne bad debts ke naam par disallowance kar di aur section 263 laga diya. AO ne actual merchant receivable write-off ko dekh liya tha records mein.
cases.issue: Kya Section 263 apply ho sakta hai jab AO ne already sab kuch check kiya hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 263 revision radd kar diya. Bola jab AO ne sab details dekh li thi toh PCIT wapas nahi khol sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO ne kisi point ko detailed tarike se dekha hai, toh usi cheez par section 263 lagana valid nahi hai. Ledger aur working clarity de do ki AO ki enquiry proper thi.

cases.case_name: Mitesh Shah Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad Bench)
cases.section: Section 37 (business expense), Section 69C (unexplained purchases), Section 115BBE (tax on unexplained income)
cases.facts: Mitesh Shah ka case tha. Department ne bogus purchases ko Section 69C me daalne ki koshish ki, taki Section 115BBE ka higher tax rate lag sake.
cases.issue: Kya bogus purchases, jo ke business expenses hai, Section 69C se treat kiye ja sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki bogus purchases sirf Section 37 se hi disallow ho sakte hain. Sirf isliye ki zyada tax rate lag jaye, section 69C nahin lagaya ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke purchases genuine nahi lagte to department unhe high tax wali unexplained income me shift nahi kar sakta, jab tak wo actual business expenses hi hain.

cases.case_name: MRF Ltd. Vs DCIT (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: MRF Ltd. ne MRF Pace Foundation ki expenditure ko business deduction ke liye claim kiya. Department ne isko mana kar diya aur business expediency pe sawal uthaya.
cases.issue: Kya Pace Foundation ki expense ko business expenditure maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: High Court ne bola ki business ki zarurat assessee khud decide karega. Ye kharcha Section 37 ke tehat deducible hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar koi kharcha aapke business se directly ya indirectly related hai to aap Section 37 ke under deduction claim kar sakte hain, chahe department ko zaroori na lage.

cases.case_name: Mercy Home Vs ITO (ITAT Guwahati Bench)
cases.facts: Mercy Home ko 80G approval mila tha, jo AY 2027-28 tak valid tha. Department ne fir bhi deduction deny kar diya.
cases.issue: Jab 80G approval valid hai to kya deduction mana kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, jab tak approval valid hai, deduction deny nahi kiya ja sakta. Approval hi sabse bada document hai.
cases.takeaway: NGO ya trust ko apna valid 80G approval sambhal ke rakhna chahiye. Agar approval hai to department deduction mana nahi kar sakta.

cases.court: Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, Jodhpur Bench
cases.case_name: Shri Harish Panwar Vs Income Tax Officer
cases.facts: Shri Harish Panwar ne partnership firm se cash nikaala tha aur ye paisa demonetisation ke baad apne account me jama kiya. Income Tax department ne ye 68.85 lakh cash deposit ko unexplained maan kar addition kar di.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit ka source sahi tarah explain ho gaya tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki assessee ne partnership withdrawals se source explain kar diya tha. Section 115BBE (unexplained income pe higher tax) bhi yahan lagu nahi hota. Isliye pura addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation time ke cash deposits ka source dikhana zaruri hai. Agar partnership se withdraw kar rakha hai to uska proof rakhna chahiye.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Maheshwari Coal Benefication and Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd.
cases.facts: Company par 1.15 crore ka addition kiya gaya kyunki Income Tax officer ne loan entries ko bogus maana. Assessee ne dikhaya ki ye loans waapas kar diye the isliye addition galat hai.
cases.issue: Kya repaid loans ke liye Section 68 ka addition justified hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki loans waapas kar diye gaye the. Isliye Section 68 (unexplained cash credits) ka addition yahan sahi nahi hai. Interest disallowance bhi hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan repay ho chuka hai to uska record dikhana chahiye. Tab Section 68 ka addition nahi hoga.

cases.case_name: Rajlaxmi Constructions Ltd Vs Union of India And Others
cases.facts: GST department ne 28.80 crore ka order pass kiya bina sune. Assessee ne bola ki unko apna case rakhne ka mauka hi nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya bina hearing diye GST order pass ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola bina sunwaye order pass karna natural justice ka ulangan hai. Pura order radd kar diya aur matter wapas department ko bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: GST case mein order pass karne se pehle notice aur hearing milna zaruri hai. Agar nahi mili to order challenge ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Ashok Ramanlal Tamboli Vs ITO
cases.facts: Assessee ko cash transaction par 31.95 lakh ki penalty Section 271D (cash loan/advance limit par penalty) lagi thi. Co-sharer ko usi transaction me pehle relief mil chuki thi.
cases.issue: Kya agar co-sharer ko relief mil gaya hai to doosre ko bhi mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki same transaction mein co-sharer ko relief mil gaya hai. Assessee ka explanation bhi maana. Isi wajah se penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap ek joint transaction me hain aur co-sharer ko penalty me relief mil chuki hai to apne liye bhi uska reference le sakte ho.

cases.case_name: K.P. Sugandh Limited Vs Chief Commissioner of CT and GST, Odisha
cases.facts: GST department ne penalty order 8th din communicate kiya jab ki law kehta hai 7 din ke andar karna hai. Company ne challenge kiya ki deadline miss ho gayi.
cases.issue: Kya 7 din ka time limit mandatory hai penalty order serve karne ke liye?
cases.held: Court ne bola 7 din ki limit mandatory hai. 8th din ka order invalid hai. Isliye penalty order radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: GST penalty notice strictly 7 din ke andar hi serve hona chahiye. Agar late ho gaya to pura order challenge ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: State Bank of India Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: SBI par Leave Travel Concession (LTC) TDS na kaatne ka ilzaam tha. Madras High Court ke interim order ke period mein department ne TDS demand lagayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya interim court directions ke dauraan TDS deduct na karne par bank ko default maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne SBI ko default nahi maana. Bola, Madras HC ke stay order ke samay TDS na kaatna galat nahi tha. Section 201 ki demand hata di.
cases.takeaway: Jab interim High Court stay mil jaye, to us dauraan ka TDS non-deduction liability nahi banega. Court order ki copy sambhal ke rakho, aur us period ka hi benefit milega.

cases.case_name: Ashok Ramanlal Tamboli Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ek vyakti par 31.95 lakh ka penalty Section 271D mein lagi thi, kyunki usne cash loan liya tha. Par co-sharer ko pehle relief mil chuka tha same transaction mein.
cases.issue: Kya jab co-sharer ko relief mil chuka hai, doosre par bhi penalty tikti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki co-sharer ko already relief mil chuki hai, aur taxpayer ka explanation bhi reasonable tha. Penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar ek hi transaction mein kisi aur ko relief mil gaya ho, to apne case mein woh order jarur lagao. Department ko pehle ki order dikhana faida de sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Agilent Technologies (International) Pvt. Ltd. Vs ACIT/NFAC (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ne apni CSR spending par Section 80G deduction claim kiya tha. Department ne isko mana kar diya. Company ke rental addition ko bhi dispute kiya gaya, kyunki Form 26AS update hua tha.
cases.issue: CSR expenditure par 80G deduction mil sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki CSR kharch par Section 80G ka deduction allowed nahi hai. Rental wale issue ko wapas department ko verify karne bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: CSR spending ka 80G deduction expect mat karo, Supreme Court/HC order ke bina. Rental receipts ke proof Form 26AS se zarur match karao.

cases.case_name: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company ne apne CSR donations par Section 80G deduction claim kiya tha. Department ne pehle deny kar diya. Saath hi DDT refund bhi issue tha.
cases.issue: Eligible CSR donations par 80G deduction milni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, jo CSR donation eligible hai, uspe 80G ka deduction milega. Excess DDT refund bhi verify kar ke dene ka kaha.
cases.takeaway: CSR donation par Section 80G ka deduction sirf un cheezon par jo eligibility criteria fulfill kare. DDT ya dusre refunds ke claim par hamesha proof ready rakho.

cases.case_name: K.P. Sugandh Limited Vs Chief Commissioner of CT and GST, Odisha (Orissa High Court)
cases.facts: Company par GST violation ke liye penalty lagayi gayi. Order 7 din baad communicate hua tha, jabki law mein 7 din ki limit hai.
cases.issue: Agar penalty order 7 din ki limit cross kar de to kya valid hai?
cases.held: Orissa HC ne GST penalty order ko radd kar diya. Bola, 7 din mein communication mandatory hai, uske baad order valid nahi.
cases.takeaway: GST penalty ka order mile to turant dekh lo ki communication 7 din ke andar hua ya nahi. Agar delay hai to order challenge karo reference se.

cases.case_name: Sharad Jain Vs ITO (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Taxpayer par 37.30 lakh ka penalty lag gaya tha, kyunki assessment mein bogus purchase ka estimate ad hoc basis par add kiya tha.
cases.issue: Ad hoc bogus purchase addition par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, sirf estimate ad hoc addition pe concealment penalty nahi lag sakti. Penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein sirf estimate ya ad hoc addition hue hai, to Section 271(1)(c) ki penalty ko zarur challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Jubilant Avenues Private Limited Vs The Superintendent of Central Tax Kothapet Cost Range & Anr. (Andhra Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan company pe ek hi assessment order mein kai tax periods ka GST nikaal diya gaya tha. Company ne bola ki alag-alag period ka alag assessment hona chahiye. Court ne composite order hata diya.
cases.issue: Ek hi assessment order mein kai periods ko club karna sahi hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne kaha alag-alag tax periods ke liye alag orders bano. Pehle wala composite order hata diya, aur limitation ka time is process ke liye exclude kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke business pe ek saath kai saal ka tax ek order mein lagaya gaya ho, to turant challenge karo. Har period ka alag order mang sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Halton India Private Limited Vs Customs Authority (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek import ke kitchen exhaust hoods ki classification par dispute tha. Customs Authority ne pehle hi decide kar diya tha bina ekstra saboot dekhe ki product mein fan hai ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya imported hood ke andar fan hai ya nahi, aur kaunsi category mein aayega?
cases.held: Court ne pehli ruling hata di. Bola, pehle pura evidence dekho aur dubara faisla lo.
cases.takeaway: Product ki asli tareekh, photos ya technical literature submit karne ka mauka banta hai; incomplete hearing pe decision ho, to challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Gajendra Singh Cont. Vs Assistant Commissioner And Another (Uttarakhand High Court)
cases.facts: Ek contractor ka GST registration cancel ho gaya. Department ne bina usko bolne ka mauka diye order pass kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina personal hearing diye order pass karna sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne GST ka order radd kar diya. Bola, reply aur sunnwai ke bina order valid nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar registration cancel ho ya assessment ka notice aaye, toh hamesha personal hearing ki demand likhit mein karo.

cases.case_name: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd Vs DCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Sun Pharma ne ek LLP mein capital loss dikhaya, amount tha ₹263.69 crore. Department ne isko nahi maana aur kuch aur MAT claims par bhi disput tha.
cases.issue: Kya LLP capital loss ka figure sahi hai aur valuation kaise hoga?
cases.held: ITAT ne valuation ka mudda wapas department ko bhej diya jaise ki aur check kiya ja sake. Kuch MAT claims par relief mil gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar bade capital loss claim kar rahe ho to valuation ka poora backup ready rakho. Dispute aaye toh details ke saath dobara defence karna pad sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Indus Valley Partners (India) Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Indus Valley Partners ka ₹72.85 crore ka transfer pricing adjustment lag gaya tha intra-group transactions pe. Company ne bola ki aggregation sahi hai aur foreign group ko tested party maana jaye.
cases.issue: Kya transfer pricing aggregation aur tested party approach sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne pura adjustment hata diya. Bola aggregation aur tested party dono sahi the. Section 170A ka return ka mudda department ko wapas bheja.
cases.takeaway: Aap agar foreign group transaction dikhate ho toh aggregation aur tested party ke justification ke record ready rakho, isi pe poora adjustment turn ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rakesh Krishnan Vs Deputy State Tax Officer (Kerala High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek aadmi ko ITC dena mana kar diya, reason diya return late file hua tha. Lekin return deadline Section 16(5) ke andar thi.
cases.issue: Kya Section 16(5) ke andar return file ho to ITC deny kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne ITC denial ka order radd kar diya. Bola jab tak deadline ke andar return hai, aap ITC mana nahi kar sakte.
cases.takeaway: GST ITC claim karte waqt dhyaan rakho ki return Section 16(5) ki last date se pehle file ho jaye. Deadline miss ho jaye toh dikkat ho sakti hai, warna claim valid hai.

cases.case_name: Konica Minolta Healthcare India Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Konica Minolta Healthcare India ne medical equipment import kiya. In equipment par kaafi value addition ki gayi thi. Department ne transfer pricing mein method choice ko challenge kiya.
cases.issue: Kaunsa transfer pricing method sahi hai jab imported goods par major value addition hota hai?
cases.held: Court ne TNMM ko sabse theek method maana, kyunki yahan resale price method (RPM) relevant nahi tha. TNMM applicable hai jab product par significant value addition hoti hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap imported goods par substantial value addition karte hain, to transfer pricing mein TNMM method use karna sahi rahega. RPM sirf tab jab product as-is resale ho.

cases.case_name: Soni Commercial Enterprises Private Ltd Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Soni Commercial Enterprises ke against Section 153C ki assessment hui. PCIT ne Section 153D ka approval diya, par bina independent soch-vichar ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina properly soch-vichar ke di gayi Section 153D approval valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne Section 153C ki assessment radd kar di, kyunki approval mechanical tarike se diya gaya tha, bina apni independent mind lagaye.
cases.takeaway: Section 153C/153D cases mein, approval officer apni taraf se soch-vichar kare bina bas sign na kare. Warna assessment cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Huawei Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Huawei Technologies ne apne transfer pricing case mein kuch comparables (Infosys, Persistent Systems) ke selection ko challenge kiya aur working capital adjustment maanga.
cases.issue: Kya ye large IT companies proper comparables hain?
cases.held: Court ne Infosys aur Persistent Systems ko comparables se hata diya. Working capital adjustment bhi allow kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki company ka size ya business model mukhya comparables se alag hai, to us basis par objection jarur raise karein. Working capital ka practical impact dikhayein.

cases.case_name: Nirav Mahendrabhai Tamboli Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Nirav Tamboli ki property sale cash mein hui thi. Department ne Section 271D ke tahat ₹15.98 lakh penalty lagayi thi, par co-owners ki consistency aur reasonable cause tha.
cases.issue: Kya genuine reason aur co-owners ki matching situation mein cash lene par Section 271D penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne penalty hattadi kyunki taxpayer ne reasonableness dikhayi aur co-owners ki story same thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko cash transaction karna pade aur genuine reason ho—specially agar co-owners ki baat match karti hai—to penalty remove ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Umesh Kumar Vs Narendra Kumar Sharma (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Umesh Kumar ne Rs.1.90 crore ka claim daala CIRP mein. Resolution Professional ne extra proof maanga, aur proper evidence na hone par claim reject kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Resolution Professional (RP) claim verify karte waqt extra documents maang sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne RP ka action sahi maana. RP aur evidence maang sakta hai, par contract ki legality nahi decide kar sakta.
cases.takeaway: Jo bhi claim file karein, uske support mein pura proof/outstanding documents ready rakhein. RP verification mein detail check karega.

cases.case_name: Ahlcon Parenterals (India) Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ahlcon Parenterals ki assessment ko PCIT ne Section 263 ke under revise kiya, par bas audit objection aur AO ki baat sun kar, apni independent mind nahi lagayi.
cases.issue: Kya PCIT bina independent check ke, sirf audit proposal par Section 263 revision kar sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne revision order hata diya, kyunki PCIT ne apna independent analysis nahi diya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar Section 263 order audit objection ya kisi aur ke kehne par diya gaya ho, to vo valid nahi. PCIT ko detail reason likhna jaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Crescent Educational & Charitable Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ye ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Department ne Rs.1 crore ka addition Section 68 (jo unexplained credits ka section hai) ke andar kiya aur saath hi Rs.94.86 lakh ki expenses bhi disallow kar di. Sab kuch AY 2018-19 ka tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ke andar ki addition aur expense disallowance justified thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki Section 68 ki Rs.1 crore ki addition aur expenses disallowance dono delete kiye jaate hain. Sahi tarah se explain kar diya gaya tha aur department ka action justified nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke bank credits ya expenses pe addition ho, to proper documentation se sab clear kar do – jaise bank statements aur expense bills dikhana mat bhoolo.

cases.case_name: SR Blue Metals Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: SR Blue Metals naam ki company ka case tha. Department ne Rs.32.56 lakh commission, Rs.1 crore loan aur Rs.62.30 lakh lorry tips ko expenses me allow nahi kiya tha. Sab additions AY 2023-24 ka tha.
cases.issue: Kya commission, loan aur lorry tips ka expense sahi tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki ye sab expenses allow kiye jaate hain, department ki disallowance galat thi. Company ne sab details aur evidence de diye the.
cases.takeaway: Jab aap koi expense claim karo, uske support me pura record aur payment details sambhal ke rakho, especially commission aur transport-related ka.

cases.case_name: Selvakumar Arumugam Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek doctor apni professional income par presumptive taxation Section 44ADA (jo professionals ke liye hai) claim kar raha tha. Department ne kuch aur additions kar diye the lekin wo doctor ne pursue nahi kiye.
cases.issue: Professional income ka 50% presumptive assess karna sahi tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne allow kiya ki saari professional receipts pe 50% ko hi income maana jaaye. Baaki additions pe kuch nahi bola kyunki applicant ne wo ground press nahi kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap professional ho (doctor, CA, etc.) to Section 44ADA ke tahat simple 50% income maan sakte ho, par receipts ki sahi calculation aur evidence rakho.

cases.case_name: IL & FS Pradip Refinery Water Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek company ka reassessment AY 2015-16 ke liye Department ne 31.07.2022 ko shuru kiya Section 148 (jo reassessment ka notice hota hai) ke under. Issue yahi tha ki notice time-barred hai ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya Section 148 ka notice time-barred tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki ye notice limit se bahar tha, isliye reassessment pura radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment ke notice ki date check karo – agar ek limit ke baad aaye to turant challenge karo.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Iddaiah Varikuppala (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Yahaan cash deposit addition aur penalty Section 271(1)(c) par baat ho rahi thi. Department ne cash deposits ko taxable maana tha aur penalty lagayi thi par lower authority ne ye sab hata diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit addition aur penalty sahi thi ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne Revenue ki appeal dismiss kar di. Addition aur penalty dono hata di gayi, toh assessee ko relief mil gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par cash deposit ka addition ya penalty lage, to ache se batao paise ka source legit hai. Agar proof ho to ITAT tak relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rekha Corporation Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Rekha Corporation Private Limited ka case tha. Department ne ₹2.38 crore unsecured loans pe Section 68 (jo unexplained credits ke liye hai) ka addition kiya tha, aur PF/ESI ka ₹1,00,268 ka disallowance bhi kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ke andar ka loan addition aur PF/ESI disallowance justified the?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 68 ka addition hata diya lekin PF/ESI disallowance ko maintain kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar unsecured loan credible dokument se dikh jaye to Section 68 ka addition nahi banega. Lekin PF/ESI timely deposit na ho to disallowance ho jayega – to usmein der mat karo.

cases.case_name: Crescent Educational & Charitable Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Department ne Rs.1 crore section 68 ke andar add kiya tha aur Rs.94.86 lakh ka expense disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya section 68 ki addition aur expense disallowance sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne dono additions hata diye. Court ko evidence theek laga aur department ka view nahi maana.
cases.takeaway: Agar section 68 ka notice aaye to proper evidence aur explanation bank statement ya party confirmation ke sath lagana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: SR Blue Metals Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Rs.32.56 lakh commission, Rs.1 crore loan aur Rs.62.30 lakh lorry tips department ne add kar diye the.
cases.issue: Kya commission, loan aur lorry tips ki additions justified thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne sabhi additions hata di. Court ne assessee ke evidence ko sahi maana.
cases.takeaway: Jitne bhi kharche ho, uska paper kaam court ke samne rakhna chahiye - jaise bills, confirmations ya receipts.

cases.case_name: Selvakumar Arumugam Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Doctor ki professional income ka case tha. Doctor ne 50% income pe tax lagaya. Baaki grounds unhone press nahi kiye.
cases.issue: Kya 50% professional receipts pe section 44ADA me tax lagana theek hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki 50% professional receipts ko hi income maana jayega. Court ne baaki appeals pe kuch nahi bola kyunki woh press hi nahi ki gayi thi.
cases.takeaway: Doctors ya professionals section 44ADA use karte waqt total receipts ka 50% hi income maane, baki record ki zaroorat nahi padti.

cases.case_name: IL & FS Pradip Refinery Water Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ko Section 148 ka notice mila for AY 2015-16. Ye notice 31.07.2022 ko issue hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya 31.07.2022 ko diya gaya notice time-barred hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko time-barred maana aur pura reassessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment ka notice assessment year ke baad zyada late aata hai, to uska limitation zaroor check karo.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Iddaiah Varikuppala (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ne cash deposit kiya tha, department ne addition ki thi aur penalty bhi lagayi thi. Revenue appeal leke aaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit addition delete karne aur penalty hatane ka decision sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne Revenue ki appeal kharij kar di. Addition aur penalty dono delete rehne di.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash deposit genuine ho aur document diye ho to penalty nahi lagti. Appeal me bhi relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rekha Corporation Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company ke upar ₹2.38 crore ka Section 68 addition tha jo unsecured loans ka tha. ₹1 lakh se upar ka PF/ESI disallowance bhi tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 aur PF/ESI disallowance sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 68 ka addition hata diya magar PF/ESI ka disallowance rakha.
cases.takeaway: Unsecured loan ka pura documentation hona chahiye. PF/ESI ki late payment par allowance nahi milegi.

cases.case_name: Amandeep Kaur Vs Assessment Unit/NFAC
cases.issue: CIT(A) ne ex parte order pass kiya bina assessee ki baat sune.
cases.held: ITAT ne order set aside kar diya aur appeal wapas bhej di fresh hearing ke liye, taki dono parties properly sun sake.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi order mein bina sunwayi ex parte decide ho jaye to uske khilaf appeal karo - proper hearing ka right hai.

cases.case_name: Harsh Jindal Pranshu Goel Vs ITO
cases.issue: GST portal se bogus purchase ka data milne par reopening kiya gaya aur issue merits par CIT(A) ko bheja gaya.
cases.held: ITAT ne mana ki GST data reopening ke liye kaafi hai, lekin merits par CIT(A) decide karega.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST portal par aapka transaction suspicious dikhe to reopening ho sakta hai, isliye purchase evidence strong rakhna chahiye.

cases.case_name: Sarang Avinash Kamtekar Vs ITO
cases.issue: CIT(A) ne additional evidence allow kiya lekin AO ki report ka intezaar nahi kiya, seedha order pass kar diya.
cases.held: ITAT ne addition restore kar diya, keh diya ki AO ki remand report ke bina order nahi pass ho sakta jab naye evidence aaye.
cases.takeaway: Agar case mein naya evidence adduce karo to AO ki remand report zarur aani chahiye, bina uske order galat maana ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: India Kawasaki Motors Private Limited Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Section 68 ke tahat trade payables ko bogus bolke ₹1.5 crore add kiya gaya tha.
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki payables genuine trade transactions the, isliye Section 68 apply nahi hoga aur addition delete kar di.
cases.takeaway: Aapke trade payables genuine business transactions proof ho jaayein, to Section 68 ki addition nahi ruk sakti.

cases.case_name: Underwater Services Company Ltd. Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Related party ko charter hire payment lower than market rate par diya, Revenue ne disallow kiya tha aur addition 153A mein ki thi.
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki comparable rates se kam charge kiya gaya aur records mein incriminating material nahi tha, isliye addition delete ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Related party transactions ka market comparability proof ho to TP aur 153A dono mein relief mil sakta hai, records proper rakhna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: PS Enterprises Vs Commissioner
cases.issue: GST registration retrospectively cancel kar diya bina proper notice ya SCN mein retrospective mention kiye.
cases.held: High Court ne retrospective GST registration cancellation ko quash kar diya, lekin fresh SCN jane diya.
cases.takeaway: Aapka GST registration bina clear notice ya SCN ke retrospectively cancel ho to High Court jane ka option hai, process ki proper compliance hona zaruri hai.
